requirements.quote: A roster or leave notice that affects a listed matter produces exactly one alert per watcher, with the notice linked.
Unaffected matters get no alert, and a test covers category-based roster assignment.
`packages/core/src/court/bench-alerts.ts`: map roster changes and notices (leave, special bench, roster reassignment) to affected listings and matters (forum, hall, judge, case category).

requirements.why: Judge-based mapping needs bench.judges; PX-9, ME-6 and D-050 (docs/product/03-prd.md:278,319, docs/adr/0017-effective-dated-rosters.md:15) make judge-level data internal-only and need counsel clearance. This change maps by forum, hall and case category; judge-name matching is separate work after clearance.

requirements.quote: `packages/notifications`: a `bench_change` category with in-app and push alerts and a daily summary.
`apps/web`: an alert card on the matter and court-day view, with the notice as its source.

deliverables.change: New. Pure classifyBenchNotice(title) -> {type: leave|special_bench|roster_reassignment, hallNos, caseTypes}|null (rules, no AI; null when it names neither a hall nor a case type). listBenchNoticeAlerts(db, actor, {matterId?, from?, to?}) read model over notice_match(matter_forum) x notice x listing x proceeding x court_hall in the actor's workspace, filtered by forum, hall number and portfolioRuleMatches, with matterVisibilityPredicate, returning notice id/title/url/kind/source name and the affected matter/listing. notifyBenchNoticeAlerts(deps, matched) notifies each active member who may read an affected matter once per notice via notify() category bench_change, dedupeKey bench-notice:<noticeId>, counts-only body. Judges are never read.
export * from './bench-alerts.ts' and update the header comment

New tests: classifier cases (leave, special bench, reassignment, unrelated, hall-less); one alert per member and notice on re-run and replay; unaffected hall/case type/forum/date gets nothing; category-based roster assignment affects only the named case types; a member who cannot read the matter is not notified; read model hides other matters
Add optional onMatched?(matched: MatchedNotice[]) to PollNoticesDeps and await it after notifyNoticeMatches, errors caught so a failing hook does not stop the poll
Pass onMatched that calls notifyBenchNoticeAlerts with the job db and the existing enqueueDelivery (jobs may import court)
Add 'bench_change' with defaultChannels ['in_app','push'], not mandatory; daily summary is the existing per-category digest preference
Add 'bench_change' to the expected category list and assert its defaults
Register listBenchNoticeAlerts and notifyBenchNoticeAlerts in SERVICE_TESTS (real cases) and classifyBenchNotice (and any other pure export) in NOT_A_SERVICE with a reason
Real cases: B on A's matter sees nothing from A's notice_match / listings; A unchanged
New card listing affected matters with the notice title as an external rel=noopener noreferrer link, source name and kind; renders nothing when empty; plus a test file beside it
Add an optional benchNotices slot rendering the card on the matter overview
Load listBenchNoticeAlerts for the matter in the existing inWorkspace read and pass it to MatterOverview; a failure renders no card
Render the card for today's and upcoming court days (court-day view), hidden when empty
Map the bench_change category to its i18n key

Add benchAlerts copy; mirror in ta and kn notices.json, add the category label and description to en/ta/kn notifications.json, regenerate generated/*, update translation-status.json and packages/i18n/src/__tests__/catalog.test.ts if keys or namespaces are enumerated there
Add the bench-alerts functions and the notices onMatched hook to the court and notices rows

preserve.what: detectBenchChanges, listAlerts, dismissAlert and the reminder.hearing notification with dedupeKey bench-change:<rosterId> in packages/core/src/court/bench-change.ts
notifyNoticeMatches output (category notices, dedupeKey notice:<id>) in packages/core/src/notices/alerts.ts, and pollNotices behaviour when onMatched is absent
Domain boundary: packages/core/src/notices must not import court (packages/config/eslint/core-domains.js:33); no new workspace package dependency; no migration
No judge reading, grouping or ranking (PX-9, ME-6); notification bodies carry no party names

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/core exec vitest run src/court/bench-alerts.test.ts src/court/bench-change.test.ts src/notices/notices.test.ts

decisions.choice: Compute bench-notice alerts on read from notice_match, listing and proceeding; no new table or migration
decisions.justification: Same read-time pattern as listHolidayListings (packages/core/src/notices/holidays.ts:1-30); a notice arriving after the listing still alerts, and no RLS catalog or seeder changes are needed

decisions.choice: Add a PollNoticesDeps.onMatched hook instead of importing court from notices
decisions.justification: notices may import only workspaces and sources (packages/config/eslint/core-domains.js:33) while jobs may import both (:93-116)

decisions.choice: Classify notice titles with deterministic rules, not AI, and ignore judge names
decisions.justification: Tagging stays kind/forum only (packages/intelligence/src/notices/tag.ts:1-5); judge data is prohibited without clearance (docs/product/03-prd.md:278,319)

decisions.choice: Watcher means an active member who may read an affected matter (matter.read plus visibility predicate)
decisions.justification: Same audience rule as notices/alerts.ts:44-109 and court/bench-change.ts noticesFor
